landmarks.name: Elizabeth Tower and Houses of Parliament
landmarks.text: Walked past Big Ben and the Houses of Parliament. Took a photo of the tower from Westminster Bridge.

landmarks.name: London Eye
landmarks.text: Rode the London Eye. Clear view all the way across the city.

landmarks.name: Red phone box
landmarks.text: Stopped at a red phone box on the way to the bus stop.

landmarks.name: Kanada-Ya
landmarks.text: Lunch at Kanada-Ya on St Giles High Street.

landmarks.name: Centre Point
landmarks.text: Centre Point towers over the corner of the street.

landmarks.name: Side shop
landmarks.text: A small shop with a noren curtain next to the ramen place.

food.text: Had tonkotsu ramen and gyoza at Kanada-Ya.

landmarks.name: Queen Mary's Rose Garden gates
landmarks.text: Walked through the gates into Queen Mary's Gardens. 3.8 km, 75 min, 5,200 steps.

landmarks.name: Triton Fountain
landmarks.text: Sat by the Triton Fountain for a while.

landmarks.name: Boating lake and bandstand
landmarks.text: Finished at the boating lake, past the swans and the bandstand.
